text:
alice: Quick heads-up — starting a gradual tilt to the new router (router-service v2.3.1) across prod regions at 12:30 UTC. Plan is 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% every 10m with automated metric gates. Pinned backend version on dedicated pools to v2.3.1 for this rollout.

bob: Ack. Are we keeping session affinity on?

alice: Yes, session affinity stays on for 30m after a user's first request (same cookie). We do NOT change affinity behavior in this rollout.

kate: Ops checklist: drain window = 2m for existing connections, idle timeout override set to 60s during shift. If we hit >0.5% 5xx or P95 latency regression >200ms vs baseline, rollback immediately.

will: I'll open a short change window note for support (30m) and ping on-call. Also uploading release notes to the runbook now.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created: tilt-id=tilt-1962023456, route=api-v1, target=router-v2.3.1, steps=[5,25,50,100], step-interval=600s. Triggered by alice.

nora: For canary metrics, include request error rate, p50/p95 latency, saturation (%GPU/CPU on dedicated), and 95th token generation time for streaming endpoints. I want a manual thumbs-up at 25% if APAC shows any variance.

infra-oncall: I'm on watch. Adding a temporary circuit-breaker at 10rps per host for the first two steps and enabling health-check tightening (2 failed checks -> mark unhealthy) to reduce blast radius.

bob: Re routing commands, use this to set weight:
```
rbctl traffic set-weight --service router-service --target router-v2.3.1 --weight 5
rbctl traffic set-weight --service router-service --target router-v2.3.1 --weight 25
```

alice: We'll run synthetic canaries for critical flows (login, stream-start, embedding) between each step. Script: `scripts/synthetics/run_canary.sh --suite prod-critical` — results posted to the release channel.

will: Noting fallback target: router-v1.9.8 (last known stable). If we detect a regression at any gate, automated fallback will re-target 100% to router-v1.9.8 and alert infra-oncall + eng-sre.

deploy-bot: Tilt step 1 (5%) started. tilt-id=tilt-1962023456-step-1. Metrics collector subscribed.

alice: Monitoring dashboard URL: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/tilt-1962023456 — watch p95, errors, and stream tokens/sec.

nora: Step-1 quick check: errors normal, p95 +10ms. Proceed to 25% in 10m unless APAC flags.

infra-oncall: APAC region slight spike in connection resets (~0.1% of traffic) — investigating, holding on moving to 25% until cleared.

bob: Suggest reducing step interval to 5m for the next step if we want to shorten window but keep caution. Thoughts?

kate: Keep 10m. Shortening hides transient issues. We need stable signal.

deploy-bot: Manual hold requested by infra-oncall. Tilt paused at 5%.

alice: Thanks infra team — whatever you need from runtime to debug, call it out. I can revert affinity tweak if that helps.

infra-oncall: Found a client TLS renegotiation pattern on older APAC edge nodes. Patch staged, rolling to edge nodes now. ETA 6m.

nora: Good catch. Once patched, re-run synthetics focused on APAC users (use flag `--region apac`).

deploy-bot: Edge patch deployed to apac-edge-nodes. Health checks returning to green.

infra-oncall: Connection resets back to baseline. Recommend proceeding to 25%.

alice: Proceeding to 25% now. deploy-bot please advance when ready.

deploy-bot: Tilt step 2 (25%) executed. tilt-id=tilt-1962023456-step-2.

will: Support notified: https://redwood.internal/changes/tilt-1962023456 — pinned note: rollback conditions (>=0.5% 5xx OR p95+200ms).

nora: Monitoring step2: p95 stable, error rate 0.12%. Streaming token latency unchanged. Standby for 50% gate.

bob: Quick note — rolling restart of router instances scheduled in 30m to pick up a non-critical perf fix; delay if tilt still mid-progress?

alice: Delay that restart until tilt completes to avoid simultaneous churn.

deploy-bot: Scheduled tilt auto-advance to 50% in 10m unless a hold or rollback occurs.

infra-oncall: All checks green from my side. No abnormal host saturation.

kate: Logging reminder: capture a 1m snapshot of request traces around each step transition and upload to the trace bucket for postmortem if needed.

nora: Step2 thumbs-up, moving to 50%.

deploy-bot: Tilt step 3 (50%) executed. tilt-id=tilt-1962023456-step-3.

will: Congrats — if 50% holds for 10m, ops will approve full 100% and change window ends. Keep on-call in the loop.

alice: If anything pops, rollback command: `rbctl traffic set-weight --service router-service --target router-v1.9.8 --weight 100` — everyone please be ready.

nora: Final checks look clean. No increases in errors or latency. Proceed to 100%.

deploy-bot: Tilt final step (100%) executed. tilt-id=tilt-1962023456-step-4. Rollout complete.

infra-oncall: Verifying long-tail traffic now — everything looks nominal. Removing temporary circuit-breaker and restoring normal health-check cadence.

will: Change window closed, release note: "router-service v2.3.1 rolled out to prod via gradual tilt; no regressions observed. Pinned fallback v1.9.8 available." Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/router-v2.3.1-notes

alice: Thanks everyone. I'll file a short post-release note with a couple of follow-up action items (trace retention, minor perf tweak follow-ups). :tada:
